gen-gf-offside-gf-hedvig-letters-sans: Hedvig Letters Sans reads friendly and current, with a wide gap where the c ends and small letters nearly as tall as capitals. Hedvig Letters Sans is happiest at a generous size, while Offside stays the loud, widely tracked voice above it.
gen-gf-offside-gf-heebo: Heebo brings a tall central band of text and curves that stop short of closing. And Offside, with its wide tracking and unshaded line, does the shouting that Heebo leaves to others, while Heebo does the steady talking.
gen-gf-offside-gf-hind-guntur: Offside's curves refuse to close, and its wide tracking gives every line a quiet, level beat. Hind Guntur follows with stamped-metal lowercase and no thick-thin shift, so the sans-serif text sits firmly under the display type.
gen-gf-offside-gf-hind-madurai: Hind Madurai reads easily, its s curves opening wide at both ends and its lowercase filling the line like capitals. And over a longer stretch that sturdy, ribbon-cut texture carries on smoothly beneath the widely tracked Offside.
gen-gf-offside-gf-hind-mysuru: Tall, tight, and unshaded. Offside sets a widely tracked, commanding line, and Hind Mysuru follows in sans lowercase that presses close to the ascender height, with each a left slightly ajar.
gen-gf-offside-gf-hind-siliguri: Loud, wide, and never quite closed. Hind Siliguri takes over below Offside with rounds that gap like a cracked bangle and a flat gray hum of constant line weight, a plain sans that stays out of the way.
gen-gf-offside-gf-hind-vadodara: Hind Vadodara keeps its thickness constant in every direction, with spacious gaps in its rounded glyphs and big, tall-bowled e and a. Offside, widely tracked and open-ended, takes the headline.
gen-gf-offside-gf-huninn: Expressive from the first word. Offside's unclosed curves and wide tracking pair with Huninn's sans-serif lowercase, which rises close to cap height, and the result is a mix of drama and tidy structure.
gen-gf-offside-gf-inter-tight: Curves that refuse to close make Offside instantly recognizable, spaced wide and level. Inter Tight sits below like bent tubing, a plain sans with short ascenders and tails held well back, so a long read stays compact.
gen-gf-offside-gf-karla: Wide-tracked and bold in attitude, Offside draws one flat gray line that never swells or thins. Karla gives a stocky, gaping-c reply below.
